# Multispectral Sentinel-2-like Small

<div class="gc-badges">
<span class="gc-badge">raster</span><span class="gc-badge">GeoTIFF</span><span class="gc-badge">EPSG:32633</span><span class="gc-badge">tiny</span><span class="gc-badge">bundled</span>

A tiny four-band uint16 Sentinel-2 L2A stack (B02, B03, B04, B08) with processing-baseline 04.00 radiometry: sentinel NoData 0, band scale 1e-4 with offset -0.1 (BOA reflectance = (DN - 1000) / 10000), and BOA_ADD_OFFSET / QUANTIFICATION_VALUE / PROCESSING_BASELINE product tags. Generated by geocase.synth, whose constants are machine-checked against a real granule's MTD_MSIL2A.xml (tests/synth/test_spec_fidelity.py).

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a four-band uint16 multispectral stack, its band ordering, and its sentinel NoData convention.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`dtype_drift`](../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`incorrect_band_order`](../risk/incorrect-band-order.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
